body: my weathered bundle entry says the experimental seed run workers brushed off chalky water. my throat tightened before county trucks reached us.
title: weathered bundle note — the first morning
gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
rival_reading: Responders could have collected the chalky water while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.

title: Under the bedroll
body: I was told everyone here had been collected in the morning. I still heard my neighbor calling from the other tent when the men packed up their list. I wrote her name where their pencil had left a blank.
rival_reading: The agricultural trial may have caused the disorder that forced improvised decisions.
gloss: A witness records a failed evacuation count or route.
